definitions.gloss: power saving; low power consumption; energy efficiency
definitions.explanation: Refers to reduced electrical power usage, either as a feature of a device or as a mode of operation designed to consume less energy.

examples.japanese: {省電力|しょうでんりょく}モードに{切|き}り{替|か}えた。
この{新|あたら}しいチップは{省電力|しょうでんりょく}{設計|せっけい}になっている。
examples.english: This new chip has a power-efficient design.

examples.japanese: {省電力|しょうでんりょく}タイプのエアコンに{買|か}い{替|か}えたら、{電気代|でんきだい}がかなり{下|さ}がった。
examples.english: After replacing the air conditioner with an energy-efficient type, the electricity bill went down considerably.

notes:
Formed from {省|しょう} (to conserve/reduce) + {電力|でんりょく} (electric power). Widely used in technology, appliance marketing, and environmental discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {省電力|しょうでんりょく}モード: power-saving mode
- {省電力|しょうでんりょく}{設計|せっけい}: power-efficient design
- {省電力|しょうでんりょく}{化|か}: making more energy-efficient
- {省電力|しょうでんりょく}タイプ: energy-saving type

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {省エネ}: energy saving — broader term covering all forms of energy, not just electricity; more commonly used in everyday speech
- {低消費電力|ていしょうひでんりょく}: low power consumption — more technical, used in specifications
- {節電|せつでん}: electricity conservation — focuses on the act of saving electricity through behavior rather than device design
